L86: # Release notes
L87: 
L88: This page documents updates to the Gemini API.
L89: ## September 17, 2026
L90: 
L91:   * Antigravity Agent 09-2026: Released `antigravity-preview-09-2026`, which replaces and deprecates `antigravity-preview-05-2026`.
L92: 
L93: If you run on a remote sandbox (`environment: "remote"`) and read only `output_text` or `model_output` steps, update the agent string and nothing else changes.
L94: If you run tools locally (`local_environment`) or parse `function_call` steps, the built-in tools changed. Parameters use PascalCase instead of snake_case, and file edits use line-range replacements instead of full rewrites.
L95: Capability  | 05-2026  | 09-2026
L96: --- | --- | ---
L97: File creation  | `write_file(path, content)`  | `write_to_file(TargetFile, CodeContent, Overwrite, Description)`
L98: File editing  | `write_file(path, content)`, full rewrite  | `replace_file_content(TargetFile, StartLine, EndLine, TargetContent, ReplacementContent)`
L99: File reading  | `read_file(path, offset, limit)`, byte offsets  | `view_file(AbsolutePath, StartLine, EndLine, ContentOffset)`
L100: Directory listing  | `list_files(path)`  | `list_dir(DirectoryPath)`
L101: File and code search  | None, agents used shell commands  | `find_by_name(SearchDirectory, Pattern, MaxDepth)` and `grep_search(SearchPath, Query, IsRegex)`
L102: Shell execution  | `code_execution(command, timeout_seconds)`  | Unchanged
L103: Web search  | `google_search(queries)`  | Unchanged
L104: See the cite7†Antigravity Agent guide. `antigravity-preview-05-2026` shuts down on October 5, 2026, tracked on the cite8†deprecations page.
L105: ## September 15, 2026
L106: 
L107:   * Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking generally available (GA): Released two new audio-to-audio models for real-time voice applications using the Live API:
L108:     * Gemini 3.8 Live (cite9†`gemini-3.8-live` ): The default option for most low-latency voice agent experiences and real-time dialogue without reasoning delays. Features interleaved reasoning, default asynchronous function calling, and full session client content updates.
L109:     * Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking (cite10†`gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking` ): High-reasoning audio-to-audio model supporting background reasoning during live audio interactions, recommended when higher background reasoning is required.
L110: To get started, see the cite11†Live API guide , the cite12†Capabilities guide , and the cite5†Thinking guide .
L111: ## September 3, 2026
L112: 
L113:   * Lyria 3.5 generally available (GA): Released the next generation of Google's music generation model:
L114: 
L115:     * cite13†`lyria-3.5` : Full-length song generation with improved musical coherence, natural vocals, and fine-grained duration and structural control.
L116: 
L117: The model supports text and image inputs and generates high-fidelity 44.1 kHz stereo audio. See the cite14†Music generation guide for details and code samples.
L118: ## September 2, 2026
L119: 
L120:   * Gemini 3.8 Flash generally available (GA): Released `gemini-3.8-flash`, our most intelligent Flash model, engineered for long-horizon software engineering, autonomous agents, and complex enterprise workflows.
L121: 
L122: To get started, see the cite15†Gemini 3.8 Flash model page and the cite16†Latest model guide .
L123: ## September 1, 2026
L124: 
L125:   * Agentic video understanding: Released agentic video understanding for Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, and 3.5 Flash-Lite across the Interactions and GenerateContent APIs. The model dynamically navigates video timelines, requesting transcripts, frames, or audio tracks on demand. This approach uses up to 88% fewer tokens for long-form content compared to static processing.
L126: 
L127: To get started, see the cite17†Agentic video understanding guide.
L128: ## August 27, 2026
L129: 
L130:   * Gemini Omni Flash generally available (GA): Released `gemini-omni-1.1-flash`, the GA version of our fast, conversational video generation and editing model. This release includes significant new capabilities:
L131:     * Video extension: Seamlessly extend existing videos by generating continuations at the end of a clip using the `extend` task or directly with a prompt.
L132:     * Interpolation (first + last frame): Generate a video transitioning between two images using the `image_to_video` task with up to 2 images.
L133:     * Resolution control: New `resolution` parameter in `video_config` supports `360p`, `720p` (default), `1080p`, and `4k` outputs. 1080p and 4K outputs are generated using upscaling.
L134: The existing `gemini-omni-flash-preview` endpoint will be deprecated on September 30, 2026.
L135: 
L136: To get started, see the cite18†Gemini Omni Flash model page and the cite19†omni guide .
L137: ## August 26, 2026
L138: 
L139:   * Gemini 3.5 Transcribe generally available (GA): Released two dedicated speech-to-text models based on Gemini's audio understanding:
L140:     * Gemini 3.5 Transcribe (`gemini-3.5-transcribe`): High-accuracy, low-latency non-streaming speech-to-text with utterance-based language detection across 85+ languages, speaker diarization, word-level timestamps, and custom vocabulary biasing (up to 1,000 terms).
L141:     * Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live (`gemini-3.5-transcribe-live`): Low-latency, bidirectional streaming speech-to-text over WebSockets using the Live API, supporting interim and finalized transcription events, Smart transcription mode, and multiple Voice Activity Detection (VAD) strategies.
L142: To get started, see the cite20†Audio transcription guide , the cite21†Live transcription guide , and the cite22†Gemini 3.5 Transcribe model page .
L143: ## August 13, 2026
L144: 
L145:   * Gemini 3.7 Flash generally available (GA): Released our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents:
L146: 
L147:     * Gemini 3.7 Flash (`gemini-3.7-flash`): Substantial improvements across software engineering, web development, and agentic workflows, available at an introductory price through December 31, 2026.
L148: 
L149: To get started, see the cite23†Gemini 3.7 Flash model page and the cite16†Latest model guide .
L150: ## July 30, 2026
L151: 
L152:   * Gemini Robotics ER 2 in public preview: Released two new embodied reasoning model endpoints for robotics:
L153: 
L154:     * `gemini-robotics-er-2-preview`: Advanced spatial reasoning, agentic code execution, multi-step tool orchestration, video moment finding, progress classification, and multi-robot coordination.
L155:     * `gemini-robotics-er-2-streaming-preview`: Optimized for real-time text streaming using the Live API, enabling low-latency robot agents with bidirectional audio and video input.
L156: Both model endpoints accept text, image, video, and audio inputs and support function calling with blocking behavior for physical robot actions. To get started, see the cite24†Gemini Robotics ER overview . For real-time streaming use cases, see cite25†Robotics with streaming .
L157: 
L158:   * Deprecation announcement: The `gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview` model will be cite26†shut down on August 31, 2026.
L159: ## July 21, 2026
L160: 
L161:   * Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite generally available (GA): Released stable, production-ready versions of our latest 3.x Flash models:
L162:     * Gemini 3.6 Flash (`gemini-3.6-flash`): Features improved token efficiency and code/agentic planning capabilities at a lower price point than 3.5 Flash, resolving developer feedback around output verbosity.
L163:     * Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (`gemini-3.5-flash-lite`): Offers a low-latency, highly cost-effective subagent option designed for high-volume automation.
L164: 
L165: To learn more, see the cite16†Latest Gemini model guide.
L166:   * Deprecated parameters: The sampling parameters `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` are now deprecated. See the cite27†Latest Gemini Model for details.
L167: ## July 6, 2026
L168: 
L169:   * cite28†Developer logs support for the Interactions API: logs for supported Interactions API calls are now viewable in the cite29†AI Studio dashboard†aistudio.google.com .
L170: ## June 30, 2026
L171: 
L172:   * Gemini Omni Flash in public preview: Released `gemini-omni-flash-preview`, a high-performance multimodal model designed for high-speed video generation and conversational video editing. Using the cite30†Interactions API , you can generate 3–10 second videos at 720p from text descriptions or animate still images, and then conversationally edit and refine the outputs. To get started, see the cite19†Gemini Omni Flash guide and the cite18†Gemini Omni Flash model card.
L173:   * Released `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image` (Nano Banana 2 Lite) to general availability (GA), our built-in multimodal model optimized for ultra-low latency and cost-effective image generation and editing. See the cite31†Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image model card and the cite32†Image generation guide.
